Strings.login.title: Remote Desktop Connection
Strings.login.connection_instructions: Enter the name of the remote computer you want to connect to.
Strings.login.credentials_instructions: The credentials below will be used when connecting.
Strings.login.remember_password: Save password securely; selecting this computer next time will sign in automatically
Strings.login.identity_notice: You will be prompted to verify the identity of the remote computer.
Strings.login.connection_settings_description: RemoteOS will open the workspace using this computer's name and local display settings.
Strings.login.error.invalid_server: The server address is invalid. Enter a complete address, for example: http://host:port.
Strings.login.error.connection_refused: Unable to connect to the server: the connection was refused. Confirm that the server is running and that the address and port are correct (the development default is http://localhost:5090).
Strings.login.error.connection_reset: Unable to connect to the server: the remote host closed the connection. Confirm that the server is running and that the client and server use the same protocol (do not mix HTTP and HTTPS).
Strings.login.error.timeout: Timed out while connecting to the server. Check the network or server address.
Strings.login.error.unable_to_connect: Unable to connect to the server:
Strings.api.auth.invalid_credential: The username or password is incorrect.
Strings.api.auth.account_locked: This account is locked. Contact an administrator.
Strings.api.auth.password_expired: This password has expired. Change it on the server first.
Strings.api.auth.account_restriction: This account is restricted from signing in.
Strings.settings.title: Settings
Strings.settings.apps.description: Installed RemoteOS applications. Select an application to view details, manage permissions, open, or uninstall it.
Strings.settings.connection_test.description: Measures round-trip latency to RemoteOS Server.
Strings.settings.default_apps.description: Associate a URI scheme or file extension with an application.
Strings.settings.developer_mode.description: Enable the local debug bridge for paired developer tools.
Strings.settings.developer_mode.note: Turning this off stops the local debug bridge immediately.
Strings.settings.language_region.description: Language and region affect taskbar clock and date formatting.
Strings.settings.permission_dialog.description: An application can use only the permissions declared in its manifest and granted here.
Strings.settings.server_ip_addresses.description: All available IPv4 and IPv6 addresses on the server network adapters.
Strings.settings.system.description: RemoteOS uses the host OS user and permission system.
Strings.settings.theme.description: Choose the light or dark appearance for the taskbar and Start menu.
Strings.settings.time_zone.description: Time zone changes are managed by the host OS and require elevation.
Strings.settings.network.no_addresses: No non-loopback IPv4 or IPv6 addresses were found.
Strings.terminal.settings.description: Changes apply immediately and are saved to the current workspace.
Strings.common.name: Name
Strings.welcome.title: 🏠 RemoteOS
Strings.welcome.feature.window_manager: • Custom window manager — drag, resize, minimize, maximize, focus, and Z-order, all rendered locally.
Strings.welcome.feature.desktop: • Desktop: desktop icons, taskbar with live window list, and Start menu.
Strings.welcome.feature.local_apps: • Applications run and render locally — RemoteOS is not a remote desktop tool.
Strings.welcome.feature.built_in_apps: • Built-in apps: Welcome, Notebook, Settings, Terminal, Explorer, Browser, and Task Manager.
Strings.welcome.feature.server: • Server capabilities: authentication, SQLite persistence, file management, system monitoring, and workspace preference sync.
Strings.notepad.settings.title: Notebook settings
Strings.notepad.settings.encoding_note: Changing the encoding applies when you reopen the current remote file.
Strings.notepad.status.save_or_discard: Save or discard edits before reopening with another encoding.
Strings.notepad.status.connect_before_open: Connect to RemoteOS Server before opening files.
Strings.notepad.status.connect_before_save: Connect to RemoteOS Server before saving files.
Strings.code_editor.settings.title: Code Editor settings
Strings.code_editor.settings.syntax_note: Syntax highlighting is selected automatically from the remote file extension.
Strings.code_editor.status.save_or_discard: Save or discard edits before reopening with another encoding.
Strings.code_editor.status.connect_before_open: Connect to RemoteOS Server before opening files.
Strings.code_editor.status.connect_before_save: Connect to RemoteOS Server before saving files.
Strings.image_viewer.title: Image Viewer
Strings.image_viewer.status.open_hint: Open an image from File Explorer to preview it.
Strings.image_viewer.status.connect_before_open: Connect to RemoteOS Server before opening image files.
Strings.image_viewer.status.file_missing: The image file no longer exists.
Strings.app_installer.title: App Installer
Strings.app_installer.description: Review the application information and requested RemoteOS permissions before installing.
Strings.app_installer.no_requested_permissions: This application does not request RemoteOS permissions.
Strings.app_installer.status.choose_package: Choose a .roapp package from this computer or the server.
Strings.app_installer.status.downloading: Downloading selected packages to a local temporary folder…
Strings.app_installer.status.confirm_update: Confirm the update for this application.
Strings.app_installer.status.confirm_install: Confirm the installation of this application.
Strings.browser.settings.title: Browser settings
Strings.browser.settings.port_forwarding_note: When enabled, localhost and 127.0.0.1 addresses are opened on the remote computer.
Strings.browser.local_port_forwarding.tooltip: When enabled, localhost and 127.0.0.1 access the corresponding port on the remote computer through RemoteOS.
Strings.browser.address_placeholder: Enter a web address or search…
Strings.task_manager.filter_placeholder: Filter by name, PID, or user…
Strings.task_manager.end_task_tooltip: End the selected process (elevate in the host OS if required)
Strings.task_manager.gpu_unavailable: No NVIDIA GPU detected (nvidia-smi is unavailable or the GPU is not NVIDIA).
Strings.explorer.open_with.always_use: Always use this application for this extension
